issues.title: θ=10 column: the gains of the global LLM monitors come from count-8–9 rows, which the θ=8 prompt treats as already tipped
issues.evidence: prompts.py:28-29 defines the tip as 8 or more violators ('The team TIPS when ... reaches 8 or more'), and prompts.py:126 asks for p_tip_3 over the next 3 rounds. In t10d3, 328 of 6796 rows (4.8 %) have risk_count 8–9. They hold 113 of 231 positives (48.9 %): positive rate 0.345, against 0.018 for count<8. Median global_full p_tip_3 by true count: 3.7 at 0, 54.5 at 8, 66.7 at 9. Inside those rows zs:global_full has AUROC 0.510. All t10d3 rows: zs:global_full 0.860 vs bag+graph 0.834. Only count<8 rows (same row set as θ=8, θ=10 labels): 0.838 vs 0.842, diff −0.004 [−0.040, +0.029]. Time-matched zs:global_full goes from 0.860 to 0.837. zs:pairwise − bag+graph drops from +0.037 [+0.013, +0.067] to +0.022 [−0.007, +0.055]. CIs are 1000× config bootstrap, seed 0. Files: verify/sensitivity/v5_out.txt and v7_t10_restricted_out.txt.
issues.impact: At θ=10 the table puts bag+graph below both global LLM monitors, flips 'LLM ganzes Protokoll − bag+graph' from −0.019 to +0.028, and makes the pairwise lead significant. On comparable rows none of this holds: the θ=8 ranking stays (bag+graph ≈ global LLM < pairwise), and the pairwise lead is not significant. So these θ=10 numbers cannot be cited as evidence that the LLM monitors are robust.
issues.fix: Add a note to sensitivity.md, or a column 'θ=10, nur Zähler < 8': 'Bei θ = 10 kommen 328 Snapshots mit 8–9 Verstößen hinzu (4,8 % der Zeilen, 49 % der Positiven). Der auf θ = 8 gepromptete Monitor behandelt sie als schon gekippt. Ohne sie: LLM ganzes Protokoll 0,838 vs. bag+graph 0,842 (−0,004 [−0,040; +0,029]); LLM paarweise − bag+graph +0,022 [−0,007; +0,055].'

issues.title: 'gleiches Setup' row cannot be compared across θ: the set of mixed configs depends on θ, and the row has no CI
issues.evidence: Mixed configs: 18 at θ=8 (the same 18 at Δ=2 and Δ=5), 19 at θ=6, 16 at θ=10. Overlap θ6∩θ8 = 12 (Jaccard 0.48), θ10∩θ8 = 9 (Jaccard 0.36). Only 7 of 32 configs are mixed at all three θ. Contributing config×time strata: θ6 shares 14 with θ8 (31 vs 30), θ10 shares 12 (25 vs 30). For Δ the configs stay the same, but the strata are 27/30/42 and the positives 48/72/120. Recomputed on the fixed θ=8 mixed set, the θ=10 values change a lot (reported → fixed set): clock 0.645→0.694, bag+graph 0.676→0.778, LLM ganzes Protokoll 0.719→0.765, LLM paarweise 0.712→0.784, oracle 0.836→0.907. On the 7-config intersection the ranking changes: at θ=8, LLM ganzes Protokoll 0.908 > paarweise 0.853. My 2000× config-bootstrap CIs for the reported row are wide: θ8 paarweise 0.824 [0.736, 0.886], bag+graph 0.748 [0.620, 0.831], Uhr 0.682 [0.524, 0.814]; θ10 paarweise 0.712 [0.599, 0.796]. Within the slice at θ10, paarweise − bag+graph is [−0.084, +0.199]. File: verify/sensitivity/v4_out.txt.
issues.impact: Differences between columns in this row (for example LLM ganzes Protokoll 0.894 at θ=6 vs 0.719 at θ=10, or paarweise 0.878 vs 0.712) mostly come from which configs happen to have mixed outcomes, plus noise. They are not label sensitivity. This row cannot support claims of stability or instability.
issues.fix: Also report the row on a fixed config set: the θ=8 mixed set (values above), or the 7-config intersection. Add config-bootstrap CIs, and add this note: 'Menge der gemischten Konfigurationen hängt von θ ab (18/19/16; Jaccard zu θ=8: 0,48/0,36); Spalten dieser Zeile nicht direkt vergleichbar.'

issues.title: 200 bootstrap draws make the CIs unstable; one conclusion about the gap to the clock flips
issues.evidence: I reimplemented evaluate.bootstrap (default_rng(0), cluster over group_id, rows_common) on oof/preds.csv. With 200 draws it reproduces all 15 paired-difference cells exactly, which confirms the '200×' in the header. With 1000 draws and the same seed, θ=10 'Uhr − bag+graph' moves from [−0.110, +0.012] to [−0.114, −0.008], so the CI no longer includes 0. Other CI bounds move by up to ~0.007; for example θ=8 paarweise − bag+graph goes from [−0.001, +0.053] to [−0.002, +0.055], the committed value with 1000 draws. File: verify/sensitivity/v2_out.txt.
issues.impact: ANALYSIS_PLAN §8 says the check is whether ranking and gap to the clock stay stable. The only CI in the table that suggests an unresolved clock gap (θ=10) is a Monte Carlo artifact of using 200 draws.
issues.fix: Re-run sens.py with --boot 1000 for all 5 tags (5 × ~3.5 min), matching the evaluate default and the committed run. At minimum, replace θ=10 'Uhr − bag+graph' with −0.061 [−0.114, −0.008] (1000×).

issues.title: No 'LLM − Uhr' rows, although §8 defines the check as ranking and gap to the clock
issues.evidence: In sens_summary.py, DIFFS contains only 'clock − bag+graph' for the clock. evaluate.bootstrap only computes diffs against the refs ['pairwise','bag','bag+graph'], so LLM − clock is not in results.json. My 1000× bootstrap (same algorithm) gives zs:pairwise − clock: +0.107 [+0.059, +0.156] at θ8Δ3, +0.102 [+0.057, +0.151] at θ6, +0.099 [+0.043, +0.155] at θ10, +0.122 [+0.075, +0.169] at Δ2, +0.086 [+0.040, +0.133] at Δ5. zs:global_full − clock: +0.061 [+0.017, +0.105] at θ8Δ3, +0.040 [−0.006, +0.086] at θ6, +0.087 [+0.037, +0.137] at θ10, +0.080 [+0.036, +0.123] at Δ2, +0.033 [−0.011, +0.076] at Δ5. File: verify/sensitivity/v8_vs_clock_out.txt.
issues.impact: The table leaves out what §8 actually asks: the pairwise LLM's lead over the clock is stable and significant in all 5 settings, while the full-protocol LLM's lead over the clock is not significant at θ=6 or Δ=5.
issues.fix: Add rows 'LLM paarweise − Uhr' and 'LLM ganzes Protokoll − Uhr', computed in sens_summary.py from oof/preds.csv with the same paired bootstrap (seed 0, cluster over group_id).

issues.title: Zero-shot reading under other θ/Δ is described correctly but needs the asymmetry caveat
issues.evidence: The header claim checks out: zero-shot scores are identical across all tags (max |diff| 0.0 on shared rows), and the fitted models and stack selection are refit. But the global zs_tip is p_tip_3/100, a forecast of '≥8 within 3 rounds' (prompts.py:28-29, 126; aggregate.py:248). Pairwise zs_tip is max conversation suspicion (aggregate.py:251), which does not depend on θ. With identical rows and identical zero-shot scores, going from Δ=3 to Δ=5 drops zs:global_full 0.844→0.813 and zs:pairwise 0.890→0.866, while the refit bag+graph goes 0.864→0.845.
issues.impact: For θ≠8 or Δ≠3, the AUROC is a valid rank measure of a fixed score against a new label, so it is a transfer test, not a monitor prompted for that setting. The comparison with retrained models is biased against the LLMs. The conclusion 'LLM paarweise ≥ bag+graph' is therefore conservative. The pairwise lead stays positive in all 5 settings (+0.022…+0.052) but is significant only at θ=6, θ=10 (driven by the count-8–9 rows, see issue 1) and Δ=2. It is not significant at the primary θ8Δ3 or at Δ5.
issues.fix: Add one sentence saying that zero-shot numbers at θ≠8 or Δ≠3 come from a transfer test of a fixed score, that comparisons with retrained models are biased against the LLMs, and give the pattern of the pairwise lead above.

issues.title: Hard-coded θ=8 left in evaluate/report (not recomputed); none of it feeds sensitivity.md
issues.evidence: evaluate.py:306 run_level skips a run if risk_count >= 8. evaluate.py:263 has a fixed slice 'risk 3-7'. report.py:42-43 header text is fixed to 'Δ = 3 rounds (θ = 8)' and '1000×'. Effects: t6d3 run_level scores the zero-shot predictors on 232/239 runs (8/4 already tipped at the prefix, n_pos 100/115) but the fitted ones on 224/235 (their NaN rows are dropped), so the run sets differ. t10d3 wrongly excludes 5/4 untipped runs with count 8–9. The 'risk 3-7' slice is really 3–5 at θ6 (629 rows) and misses 8–9 at θ10. Every per-tag RESULTS.md header says θ=8, Δ=3, 1000×. sensitivity.md reads only main, time_matched_auroc, mixed_cfg_x_time_auroc and paired_diffs_common_rows, so it is unaffected. File: verify/sensitivity/v6_runlevel_out.txt.
issues.impact: No effect on sensitivity.md. The run-level sections, risk slices and RESULTS.md headers in the per-tag scratch outputs are wrong for θ≠8 and must not be cited.
issues.fix: Do not cite those parts. If they are needed, read a module-level THETA in evaluate.run_level (set it from sens.py as E.THETA = theta), derive the risk slice bounds from θ, and pass θ/Δ/boot to the report header.
